d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.
Reports To: F&B Supervisor / F&B Manager

As a Captain Waiter at Tivoli Hotels & Resorts, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the restaurant while delivering exceptional dining experiences to guests. You will supervise and coordinate the activities of the service team, maintain high standards of food and beverage service, and ensure guest satisfaction in accordance with Tivoli brand standards.
Provide professional, attentive, and personalized food and beverage service to all guests.
Welcome guests warmly and ensure their dining experience meets the hotel's service standards.
Take accurate food and beverage orders and provide recommendations based on guest preferences.
Ensure proper presentation and timely delivery of food and beverages.
Monitor guest satisfaction throughout the dining experience and respond promptly to requests or concerns.
Handle guest complaints professionally and escalate unresolved matters to the Restaurant Supervisor or Manager.
Maintain excellent knowledge of the restaurant menu, daily specials, promotions, and beverage offerings.
Ensure all service areas are properly prepared before, during, and after restaurant operations.
Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of waiters and other service team members.
Allocate service sections and assign duties to ensure efficient restaurant operations.
Guide and support team members in delivering consistent service standards.
Assist in training new team members on service procedures, menu knowledge, and guest interaction.
Monitor team performance and provide constructive feedback when necessary.
Coordinate with the kitchen and other Food & Beverage departments to ensure smooth service delivery.
Conduct pre-service briefings when assigned by the Restaurant Supervisor or Manager.
Ensure restaurant cleanliness, table settings, and service equipment meet Tivoli brand standards.
Monitor the quality, presentation, and accuracy of food and beverage orders before serving.
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and sanitation regulations.
Maintain proper handling and storage of restaurant equipment and supplies.
Support inventory control by monitoring service supplies and reporting shortages.
Ensure proper billing procedures and accurate handling of guest payments in accordance with hotel policies.
Promote restaurant offerings and upselling opportunities to support departmental revenue objectives.
Maintain effective communication with the kitchen, bar, and restaurant management teams.
Communicate guest preferences, dietary requirements, and special requests accurately.
Assist in coordinating special events, group bookings, and VIP dining arrangements.
Support the Restaurant Supervisor and Manager in maintaining efficient daily operations.
Promote a positive and professional working environment within the Food & Beverage team.
q: Previous experience as a Captain Waiter, Senior Waiter, or similar position within a hotel or upscale restaurant.
Experience in a luxury hospitality environment is an advantage.
Good knowledge of food and beverage service procedures and restaurant operations.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Good command of written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.
Ability to supervise and motivate a team in a fast-paced environment.
Knowledge of Point of Sale (POS) systems and restaurant billing procedures is preferred.
Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
Professional appearance, positive attitude, and guest-oriented approach.
Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
Adaptability and ability to work under pressure
Consistently maintain high standards of guest service in accordance with Tivoli Hotels & Resorts expectations.
Comply with all hotel policies, procedures, grooming standards, and service guidelines.
Maintain confidentiality of guest information and hotel operations.
Follow health, safety, hygiene, and security regulations.
Participate in departmental meetings, training sessions, and development programs.
Support the Food & Beverage management team in achieving departmental objectives, guest satisfaction targets, and operational efficiency.
Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by management to support hotel operations.

r: Responsible in development, review and update of training material with the latest published technology and regulatory reference that will ensure the staff are trained with the latest information.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Tax Senior Associate, reporting to the CFO. This role covers multiple Canonical corporate entities in several countries. We have a preference for candidates in EMEA time zones.

This is a unique opportunity for an astute and forward-thinking tax professional to build a tax function from the ground up at a profitable, fast-growing technology company. We're looking for someone with a keen interest in technology and how technology is changing the tax profession, who can translate that insight into a modern, effective strategy and hands-on execution.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you will design and own the tax processes that support our global expansion. Your primary challenge will be navigating the complexity of the evolving global environment in which we operate, where tax rules are constantly evolving. You will work with the CFO to establish a scalable and efficient framework fit for a dynamic, global software business—tackling everything from digital services taxes to leveraging new tax technologies.

In our selection process, we prioritize intellect and strategic thinking over years of experience. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, a professional qualification in accounting and tax and demonstrable exposure to global tax considerations in a multinational context.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region, or may be office based in London, UK
Manage and coordinate the preparation and review of corporate tax, VAT, and other relevant tax returns for our entities, ensuring timely and accurate filings
Work with external advisers to develop transfer pricing documentation and tax planning initiatives and lead their implementation
Act as a key point of contact for tax authority audits and enquiries, preparing responses and supporting documentation in collaboration with external advisors.
Identify opportunities to streamline and improve tax processes, controls, and data management to enhance efficiency and accuracy particularly using technology and automation
Manage and run tax provisioning and reporting under IFRS, including calculating effective tax rates and preparing tax-related disclosures for financial statements
Work closely with the wider finance team, legal, and business operations to provide tax support and ensure cross-functional alignment
Monitor changes in tax legislation across the regions in which we operate and assess their potential impact on the company.
q: Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics, technology or other quantitative field
Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA) and tax advisor (CTA, ADIT or equivalent)
A minimum of 3-5 years of relevant tax experience, gained within a Big 4/Top 10 accounting firm or a multinational in-house tax team.
Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tax concepts to non-tax stakeholders
Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Public company finance and reporting experience
x: We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
